items.title: What Moderna & Merck's cancer vaccine breakthrough means for healthcare stocks
items.summary: Moderna (MRNA) and Merck (MRK) reported promising results in their melanoma vaccine trial, sending the stocks soaring. BD8 Capital Partners CEO and CIO Barbara Doran and Yahoo Finance Markets and Data Editor Jared Blikre chat with Yahoo Finance Executive Editor Brian Sozzi about what the breakthrough could mean for Pfizer (PFE) and the larger healthcare sector.

items.title: Pharma Stocks Have Rallied. 2 Stocks to Avoid—and 2 to Buy.
items.summary: The  home to some large pharma companies and many smaller biotechs, have risen over 6% this week.  The main catalyst was that  Moderna  and  Merck  announced successful trial data for a melanoma vaccine that reduces the risk patients will experience recurrence.  “The read-through [from Merck and Moderna] to the others is probably indicative of a broader tailwind of pharma taking some strong actions to improve their long-term growth profiles,” says Cantor Fitzgerald analyst Carter Gould.
